config.entry_rule: At completed 4h bar i: strong BULL/BEAR context from training q67(abs((EMA20-EMA50)/ATR14)); ATR14/close <= training q67; bar touches EMA20 and closes back on trend side of EMA20 and EMA50. Enter at next bar open.
config.exit_rule: 1.5 ATR14 stop; 2R target; max 6 bars/24h; if stop and target both touched in one OHLC bar, stop first; stop gap fills at open, target gap fills at target.
